for.zh: 在外租屋的人：保你的東西、你對房東和鄰居的責任，和出事後暫住的費用
for.en: People who rent: your belongings, what you owe the landlord or neighbours, and somewhere to stay after a loss

questions.zh: 你住哪裡？（區、路名或捷運站就好）
questions.en: Where do you live? (a district, street or station is enough)
About how big is the place, in ping (3.3 m²)?

questions.zh: 家裡的東西全部重買大約要多少錢？（家具、電器、衣服、3C）
questions.en: What would it cost to replace everything you own there? (furniture, appliances, clothes, devices)

questions.zh: 其中單件超過 1,500 美元的貴重物品總共多少？（相機、珠寶、名錶）
questions.en: Of that, how much is in single items over $1,500 (cameras, jewellery, watches)?

questions.zh: 過去三年申請過幾次類似的理賠？
questions.en: How many similar claims have you made in the last three years?

questions.zh: 自負額要多少？（越高保費越低）
questions.en: Which deductible? (higher means a lower premium)

coverages.zh: 個人財物（火災、竊盜、水損、意外損壞）
coverages.en: Your belongings (fire, theft, water damage, accidental damage)

coverages.zh: 對他人的責任（房東、鄰居、訪客）
出事無法居住時的暫住費用
coverages.en: Somewhere to stay when the home can't be lived in

coverages.zh: 訪客在你家受傷的醫療費
coverages.en: Medical costs of a guest hurt in your home

addons.zh: 貴重物品逐項保（含遺失、意外損壞，不扣自負額）
addons.en: Valuables listed item by item (loss and accidental damage too, no deductible)

addons.zh: 3C 意外損壞加強（手機、筆電摔壞、進水）
addons.en: Device accidental damage (dropped or wet phones and laptops)

claims.en: A phone or laptop was dropped or got wet

claims.zh: 漏水或水管破裂弄壞東西
claims.en: A leak or burst pipe damaged things

claims.zh: 我弄壞了房東或鄰居的東西
claims.en: I damaged my landlord's or a neighbour's property
The home can't be lived in for now
A guest was hurt in my home

clauses.zh: 「個人財物」指你本人或同住家人所有、放在承保地址內的物品，包括家具、電器、衣物和個人用 3C 產品。車輛、現金、有價證券、寵物和營業用的物品不屬於個人財物。
clauses.en: "Belongings" are things you or family living with you own and keep at the insured address: furniture, appliances, clothes and personal devices. Vehicles, cash, securities, pets and things used for a business are not belongings.

clauses.zh: 「重置成本」指用同等級、同功能的新品取代損失物品所需的費用。我們依重置成本理賠，不扣折舊，但以購買時的價格為上限的物品除外（見 RT-4.3）。
clauses.en: "Replacement cost" is what it costs to replace a lost item with a new one of the same kind and quality. We pay replacement cost without depreciation, except where RT-4.3 caps it at the purchase price.

clauses.zh: 個人財物因火災、雷擊、爆炸、竊盜、搶奪、水管破裂或漏水、颱風或地震造成的屋內損壞而毀損或滅失時，我們依重置成本扣除自負額後理賠，以保單所載個人財物保額為上限。竊盜須於發現後 24 小時內向警方報案，並提供報案證明。
clauses.en: When belongings are damaged or lost through fire, lightning, explosion, theft, robbery, a burst pipe or leak, or damage inside the home from a typhoon or earthquake, we pay replacement cost less the deductible, up to the belongings limit on the policy. A theft must be reported to the police within 24 hours of finding it, with the report number.

clauses.zh: 你因過失造成房東、鄰居或訪客的財物損壞或身體傷害，依法應負賠償責任時，我們代為賠償，每一事故以 10 萬美元為上限。你不得在未經我們同意下承認責任或私下和解。
clauses.en: When you are legally liable for damage to the property of, or injury to, your landlord, a neighbour or a guest through your negligence, we pay it, up to $100,000 per event. Don't admit liability or settle privately without our agreement.

clauses.zh: 承保事故使承保地址無法居住時，我們支付合理的暫住費用（旅館或短租），每日最高 100 美元，合計最高 3,000 美元，直到可以居住或滿 30 日為止。
clauses.en: When an insured event makes the home unliveable, we pay reasonable costs of staying elsewhere (a hotel or short let), up to $100 a day and $3,000 in all, until it can be lived in again or for 30 days at most.

clauses.zh: 訪客在承保地址內意外受傷，不論你是否有過失，我們支付其醫療費用，每人最高 1,000 美元，不扣自負額。你本人和同住家人不適用。
clauses.en: When a guest is accidentally hurt at the insured address, whether or not it was your fault, we pay their medical costs, up to $1,000 a person, with no deductible. Not for you or family living with you.

clauses.zh: 故意行為、詐欺，或你本人、同住家人或其指使之人所造成的損失，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for loss caused on purpose or by fraud, or by you, family living with you, or anyone acting for them.

clauses.zh: 自然耗損、生鏽、蟲蛀、黴菌、逐漸滲漏（持續超過 14 日的漏水），以及物品本身的瑕疵，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for wear and tear, rust, insects, mould, slow leaks (going on for more than 14 days), or a defect in the item itself.

clauses.zh: 物品遺失、遺忘或下落不明（不是被偷），不予理賠；但已加保 RT-5.1 的逐項貴重物品除外。
clauses.en: No payment for things lost, left behind or missing (not stolen), except valuables listed under RT-5.1.

clauses.zh: 保單生效後 14 日內發生的事故，除火災和竊盜外，不予理賠（等待期）。
clauses.en: No payment for events in the first 14 days of the policy, except fire and theft (the waiting period).

clauses.zh: 戰爭、核子事故、政府沒收，以及承保地址連續空置超過 60 日期間發生的竊盜和水損，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for war, nuclear events, confiscation by a government, or theft and water damage while the home has been empty for more than 60 days in a row.

clauses.zh: 申請理賠時，你須提供：發生了什麼事、何時何地、損失物品清單，以及照片、收據或維修估價等證明。我們可以要求補件，你應在 30 日內提供。
clauses.en: To claim, tell us what happened, when and where, list what was lost, and give photos, receipts or repair quotes. We may ask for more; give it within 30 days.

clauses.zh: 申請時提供不實資料或隱匿重要事實，我們得拒絕該次理賠並終止保單；已付的理賠款應返還。
clauses.en: If a claim includes false information or hides an important fact, we may refuse it and end the policy, and any payment made must be returned.

clauses.zh: 單件物品超過 1,500 美元而未加保 RT-5.1 者，以 1,500 美元為上限；無法提供購買證明的物品，以同類物品的市價為準。
clauses.en: A single item over $1,500 that isn't listed under RT-5.1 is paid up to $1,500; an item with no proof of purchase is paid at the market price of similar items.

clauses.zh: 每一事故扣除一次自負額。同一原因在 72 小時內造成的多項損失視為同一事故。
clauses.en: One deductible per event. Losses from one cause within 72 hours are one event.

clauses.zh: 加保的貴重物品逐項列在保單上，以列載金額為上限；保障範圍擴及遺失和意外損壞，且不扣自負額。
clauses.en: Listed valuables are each covered up to the amount listed, including loss and accidental damage, with no deductible.

clauses.zh: 3C 意外損壞加強：你的手機、平板、筆電因掉落、碰撞或液體造成損壞，我們支付維修費，無法維修時依重置成本理賠，每年合計最高 2,000 美元，每件每年以兩次為限。每次自負額 50 美元（不適用 RT-4.4 的自負額）。
clauses.en: Device accidental damage: when your phone, tablet or laptop is damaged by a drop, a knock or liquid, we pay the repair, or replacement cost if it can't be repaired, up to $2,000 a year and twice a year per device. The deductible is $50 a claim (instead of the policy's deductible under RT-4.4).

clauses.zh: 保費可月繳或年繳。月繳扣款失敗時，你有 14 日寬限期，期間保障照常；逾期未繳，保單自寬限期屆滿日起停效，補繳後復效，停效期間發生的事故不予理賠。
clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly. If a monthly payment fails you have 14 days' grace with cover as usual; unpaid after that, the policy lapses from the end of the grace period and is reinstated when paid, but events while lapsed are not covered.

clauses.zh: 你可以隨時退保，我們依未經過的日數退還保費，不收手續費。保單內容可隨時變更，變更後立即重新計價，多退少補。
clauses.en: Cancel any time: we refund the premium for the days left, with no fee. Change the policy any time: it is priced again at once, and we refund or charge the difference.

clauses.zh: 保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池，用於理賠與再保險。年度結算後，你所選公益組別的理賠池若有剩餘，捐給該公益團體，不退還給個人。
clauses.en: 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee; the rest goes to the claims pool, for claims and reinsurance. After the year closes, what is left in the pool of your chosen cause's group is given to that cause, not refunded to anyone.
